en.headline: Showers linger this weekend before a cooler Monday
en.dek: The Observatory expects cloudy spells and showers on Saturday and Sunday, then a fresher northeast monsoon from Sunday night.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory's Friday forecast said the northeast monsoon will affect southern China over the weekend, while upper-air disturbances continue to bring showers.

Saturday is expected to be mainly cloudy with a few showers, and with more showers and thunderstorms in some areas at first. Winds will be east force 3 to 4. Temperatures should range from 27 to 31 degrees, with relative humidity of 70 to 95 per cent. The chance of significant rain is medium to high.

Sunday should stay mainly cloudy with a few showers and some sunny intervals. East force 3 to 4 winds are forecast to turn northerly force 4 to 5 at night, when a replenishment of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach the Guangdong coast. Temperatures remain 27 to 31 degrees, with humidity of 65 to 90 per cent and a medium-low chance of significant rain.

The Observatory said it will be windier and showers should ease early next week. Mornings will be slightly cooler, with the minimum temperature falling to about 24 degrees, before generally fine and dry weather in the middle of the week. A broader outlook covering the National Day holiday stretch was issued on Wednesday; Friday's bulletin sets the Saturday and Sunday detail.

zh.headline: 周末仍有驟雨 周一早上稍涼
zh.dek: 天文台預料周六日大致多雲有驟雨，周日晚東北季候風補充，隨後轉涼及雨勢減弱。
body: 香港天文台周五的預報指出，東北季候風會在周末影響華南，高空擾動亦會為該區帶來驟雨。
周六大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨，初時部分地區驟雨較多及有雷暴。吹東風3至4級，氣溫27至31度，相對濕度70%至95%，顯著降雨概率中高。
周日大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨，日間短暫時間有陽光。東風3至4級，晚上轉北風4至5級。天文台預料一股東北季候風補充會在周日晚抵達廣東沿岸。氣溫仍約27至31度，相對濕度65%至90%，顯著降雨概率中低。
天文台說，下周初風勢較大，驟雨會逐漸減少，早上稍涼，最低氣溫降至約24度，周中漸轉天晴乾燥。周三曾就國慶假期一段發出較闊的展望，周五的九天天氣預報則交代周六及周日的細節。
